FN-4US51II-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 292
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Rodger M. Smitherman
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/07/2025
Senate Bill 292 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the State
Department of Education to appoint special investigators to investigate matters the Department
and State Board of Education has authority to administer or regulate, pursuant to the provisions
of this bill, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of special investigators
appointed and the salaries and benefits provided to the investigator.
This bill could also increase the obligations of ALEA's Criminal Justice Information Services
Division to audit access to law enforcement records and systems by special investigators
pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
